X79.question: Is the Tesla M40 still the right GPU for the X79 nodes?
X79.answer: M40 stays. 2x per node (48GB VRAM), power-limited to 150W each via nvidia-smi (decode is VRAM-bandwidth bound, ~10 tok/s holds at 150W; only prefill slows). Buy 7 more M40s (~$125 each) for uniformity

X79.question: Where does Shakespeare (70B) live permanently?
X79.answer: Shakespeare's permanent home is the dual-M40 X79 node. "Always home for Shakespeare." 70B Q4_K_M (~40GB) fits in 48GB with headroom for context. ~8-12 tok/s at 150W power limit.

X79.question: What workload do the X79 nodes serve?
X79.answer: Batch content factory: blog posts, web page sales content, video scripts, email sequences. Nobody waits interactively — throughput over hours matters, not latency. ~10 tok/s = ~100+ articles per node
